name: Elem1
description: A temporal network describing face-to-face interactions of students in an elementary school in Utah, USA. Nodes represent individuals. Original data are pairwise contacts; hyperedges are constructed by promoting cliques of contacts into higher-order group interactions.

hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).

edges_metadata.time: (INT) Contact event timestamp (relative time in seconds) (e.g., 32260).
